---
title: "Electric Class Check"
output: html_document
params: 
  file_check: file_check
  dbname: dbname
  host: host
  port: port
  user: user
  password: password
---

```{r, echo = FALSE, include = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}

options(scipen = 999)

class_data <- file_check |> 
  janitor::clean_names()

#connect to data warehouse
db <- RPostgreSQL::dbConnect(RPostgreSQL::PostgreSQL(),
                 dbname = dbname, 
                 host = host, 
                 port = port, 
                 user = user, 
                 password = password)

```

```{sql connection=db, echo = FALSE, output.var = "utility_table"}

SELECT DISTINCT utility_name, mn_utility_id AS utility_id
FROM energy.utility_info 

```

Check for duplicate entries
```{r, echo = FALSE}
dup_check <- class_data |>
  dplyr::mutate(row_id = paste(utility_id, classification_of_energy_delivered_to_ultimate_consumers,
                               as.character(year), sep = "_")) |> 
                  dplyr::group_by(row_id) |>
  dplyr::mutate(count = dplyr::n()) |>
  dplyr::filter(count > 1)

if(nrow(dup_check) == 0){

  print("No duplicates found")

} else{

  print("The following rows are duplicates")

  DT::datatable(dup_check)

}
```

valid_name_check(class_data, utility_table)

Check that each utility ID is assigned to only one utility

```{r, echo = FALSE}

dup_name_check(class_data)

```
Check that each utility is only assigned on ID

```{r, echo = FALSE}
dup_id_check(class_data)
```

Check for invalid customer classes

```{sql connection = db, echo = FALSE, output.var = "valid_classes"}
SELECT DISTINCT customer_type 
FROM energy.all_class
```

```{r, echo = FALSE}
class_data |> 
  dplyr::rename(class = classification_of_energy_delivered_to_ultimate_consumers) |> 
  dplyr::filter(!c(class %in% valid_classes$customer_type) & class != "Entered Total")
```
